correctness.rationale: Starting with established pure-noise intensity rho=1+(4π)^{-1}(log P)ʺ, equality integrates to P_T=C exp(aω) P_S. With mu_S=e^{-2πx²}S(x)dx finite, P_S(ω)=e^{-2πω²} F_S(4πω); entire bilateral Laplace transforms and uniqueness of characteristic functions yield translated mu and T(x)=C exp(ax-a²/(8π))S(x-a/(4π)). Two-sided polynomial lower bound contradicts polynomial upper bound if a≠0; compact-band exponential tilts exhibit arbitrarily separated indistinguishable spectra. Gaussian-posterior differentiation gives rho=4π Var(X_ω)>0; constant rho yields Gaussian mgf, then polynomial upper bound implies rho≤1 and centered/shifted Gaussian or constant S. All limits and normalizations checked analytically; numerical quadrature is corroboration only.
